title: Answer fare searches from a set that pricing keeps changing

blocks.text: The fare search keeps the fares on sale for a route, in cents, in a `ConcurrentSkipListSet` that pricing threads change all the time. The search page has two filters. "From 64.00 to 110.00" must show a fare of exactly 110.00. "Under 40.00" must not show a fare of exactly 40.00. A result the page has already shown must not change underneath it while the customer scrolls.
Finish `between(min, max)` and `under(limit)` in `src/main/java/practice/FareIndex.java`. Both return the matching fares lowest first, as they are when the method runs. About two lines in total.

cases.says: both filters return the fares inside their range, lowest first
a range with no fares in it gives an empty answer
the from-to filter includes a fare equal to either of its limits
a search result does not change when fares are offered or withdrawn after the search
the under filter leaves out a fare equal to its limit

origin.section: A Sorted Set Answers Ranges Through Views Backed by the Set

concepts: The two-argument subSet and headSet include the lower bound and exclude the upper one; the four-argument forms set each bound.
subSet, headSet and tailSet return views that follow later changes to the set; a result that must stay fixed is a copy.
